record.paper_title: Conferences WORDS, years 1997-2017: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Is there a pattern that is 6-avoidable but not 5-avoidable?

evidence.quote: Is there a pattern that is 6-avoidable but not 5-avoidable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let A_k denote an alphabet of k letters, and let E denote a separate alphabet of pattern variables. A pattern is a nonempty word p over E. An infinite word w over A_k is said to avoid p if there is no nonerasing morphism h: E* -> A_k* such that h(p) occurs as a factor of w. The pattern p is called k-avoidable if there exists an infinite word over some alphabet of size k that avoids p; otherwise p is k-unavoidable. The avoidability index of an avoidable pattern p is the least integer k such that p is k-avoidable.

Question: Does there exist a pattern p whose avoidability index equals 6, i.e., a pattern p that is 6-avoidable but not 5-avoidable?
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears to remain open. Patterns with avoidability index 2, 3, 4, and 5 are known (a pattern of avoidability index 5 was constructed by Clark / Ochem), but no pattern with avoidability index 6 (or larger) has been exhibited, and the existence of such a pattern is listed as an open problem in the literature on combinatorics on words.

status_evidence.title: Unavoidable pattern - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Is there an avoidable pattern p such that the avoidability index of p is 6? It remains an open problem to construct such patterns for q ≥ 5 (with q=5 only recently resolved).
status_evidence.claim: The existence of a pattern of avoidability index 6 is stated as open.

status_evidence.title: The Existence of a Pattern Which Is 5-avoidable but 4-unavoidable
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a pattern with avoidability index exactly 5.
status_evidence.claim: Patterns of avoidability index 5 exist; the analogous question for index 6 is the next case.

status_evidence.title: Avoidable Formulas in Combinatorics on Words (Clark thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of avoidability indices of patterns and open problems including index ≥ 6.
status_evidence.claim: No pattern of avoidability index 6 is known.
